40021597.author: पदार्थः
40021597.content: विसृज्य having dismissed, च and, महाबाहुः the mighty-armed one, ऋक्षवानरराक्षसान् the bears, monkeys, and Rakshasas, भ्रातृभिः with his brothers, सहितः accompanied, रामः Rama, प्रमुमोद rejoiced greatly, सुखं happily, सुखी happy

40021597.author: Translation
40021597.content: And the mighty-armed Rama, having dismissed the bears, monkeys, and Rakshasas, was very happy and rejoiced greatly along with his brothers.

40021598.author: पदार्थः
40021598.content: अथ then, अपराह्णसमये in the afternoon, भ्रातृभिः with his brothers, सह together with, राघवः Rama, शुश्राव he heard, मधुरां a sweet, वाणीं voice, अन्तरिक्षात् from the sky, प्रभाषिताम् spoken

40021598.author: Translation
40021598.content: Then, in the afternoon, Rama, along with his brothers, heard a sweet voice spoken from the sky.

40021599.author: पदार्थः
40021599.content: सौम्य O gentle one, राम O Rama, निरीक्षस्व look at, सौम्येन with a gentle, वदनेन face, माम् me, कुबेरभवनात् from Kubera's abode, प्राप्तम् arrived, विद्धि know, माम् me, पुष्पकम् Pushpaka, प्रभो O Lord.

40021599.author: Translation
40021599.content: O gentle Rama, look at me with a gentle face; know me, O Lord, to be the Pushpaka chariot that has arrived from Kubera's abode.

40021600.author: पदार्थः
40021600.content: तव your, शासनम् command, आज्ञाय having understood, गतः अस्मि I have gone, भवनम् abode, प्रति towards, उपस्थातुम् to serve, नरश्रेष्ठ O best among men, सः he, च and, माम् to me, प्रत्यभाषत replied.

40021600.author: Translation
40021600.content: O best among men, having understood your command, I went to his abode to serve, and he (Kubera) spoke to me in return.

40021601.author: पदार्थः
40021601.content: निर्जितः conquered, त्वम् you, नरेन्द्रेण by the king, राघवेण by Rama, महात्मना by the great-souled one, निहत्य having killed, युधि in battle, दुर्धर्षम् formidable, रावणम् Ravana, राक्षसेश्वरम् the lord of Rakshasas.

40021601.author: Translation
40021601.content: He said, "You have been conquered by the great-souled king Rama, the descendant of Raghu, who slew the formidable Ravana, the lord of Rakshasas, in battle."

40021602.author: पदार्थः
40021602.content: मम my, अपि also, परमा supreme, प्रीतिः joy, हते when killed, तस्मिन् that, दुरात्मनि evil-minded one, रावणे Ravana, सगणे with his retinue, च and, एव indeed, सपुत्रे with his sons, सहबान्धवे with his relatives.

40021602.author: Translation
40021602.content: He further said, "My supreme joy also arises from the killing of that evil-minded Ravana, along with his retinue, sons, and relatives."

40021603.author: पदार्थः
40021603.content: सः that, त्वम् you, रामेण by Rama, लङ्कायाम् in Lanka, निर्जितः conquered, परमात्मना by the supreme soul, वह carry, सौम्य O gentle one, तम् him, एव indeed, त्वम् you, अहम् I, आज्ञपयामि command, ते you.

40021603.author: Translation
40021603.content: He concluded, "Therefore, O gentle Pushpaka, since you were conquered by the supreme Rama in Lanka, you must carry him; I command you to do so."

40021604.author: पदार्थः
40021604.content: परमो supreme, हि indeed, एष this, मे my, कामो desire, यत् that, त्वं you, राघवनन्दनम् Rama, वहेः should carry, लोकस्य of the people, संयानं the journey, गच्छस्व go, विगतज्वरः free from distress.

40021604.author: Translation
40021604.content: This is indeed my greatest desire, that you should carry Rama and the people on their journey; therefore, go forth without any anxiety.

40021605.author: पदार्थः
40021605.content: सो that, अहं I, शासनम् command, आज्ञाय having understood, धनदस्य of Kubera, महात्मनः the great-souled, त्वत्सकाशम् to your presence, अनुप्राप्तो arrived, निर्विशङ्कः without doubt, प्रतीक्ष wait for, माम् me.

40021605.author: Translation
40021605.content: Having understood the command of the great-souled Kubera, I have arrived in your presence; therefore, wait for me without any apprehension.

40021606.author: पदार्थः
40021606.content: अदृष्यः invisible, सर्वभूतानां to all beings, सर्वेषां to all, धनदाज्ञया by Kubera's command, चरामि I move, अहं I, प्रभावेण by my power, तवाज्ञां your command, परिपालयन् obeying.

40021606.author: Translation
40021606.content: By Kubera's command, I am invisible to all beings and I move by my own power, obeying your command.

40021607.author: पदार्थः
40021607.content: एवम् thus, उक्तः addressed, तदा then, रामः Rama, पुष्पकेण by Pushpaka, महाबलः the mighty, उवाच spoke, पुष्पकं Pushpaka, दृष्ट्वा having seen, विमानं the aerial car, पुनरागतम् returned again.

40021607.author: Translation
40021607.content: Thus addressed by Pushpaka, the mighty Rama then spoke, having seen the Pushpaka aerial car returned again.

40021608.author: पदार्थः
40021608.content: यदि if, एवम् so, स्वागतं welcome, ते to you, अस्तु let it be, विमानवर O best of aerial cars, पुष्पक Pushpaka, आनुकूल्यात् due to the favor, धनेशस्य of Kubera, वृत्तदोषो fault in conduct, न not, नः our, भवेत् may it be.

40021608.author: Translation
40021608.content: If it is so, then welcome to you, O best of aerial cars, Pushpaka; due to the favor of Kubera, no impropriety shall befall us.

40021609.author: पदार्थः
40021609.content: लाजैः with parched grains, च and, एव indeed, तथा similarly, पुष्पैः with flowers, धूपैः with incense, च and, एव indeed, सुगन्धिभिः fragrant, पूजयित्वा having worshipped, महाबाहू the mighty-armed one, राघवः Rama, पुष्पकम् the Pushpaka, तदा then.

40021609.author: Translation
40021609.content: Then, the mighty-armed Rama worshipped the Pushpaka chariot with parched grains, flowers, and fragrant incense.

40021610.author: पदार्थः
40021610.content: गम्यताम् let it go, इति thus, च and, उवाच he said, आगच्छ come, त्वम् you, स्मरे remember, यदा when, सिद्धानाम् of the Siddhas, च and, गतौ in flight, सौम्य O gentle one, मा do not, विषादेन with sorrow, योजय afflict, प्रतिघातः obstruction, च and, ते to you, मा do not, भूत् let it be, यथेष्टम् as desired, गच्छतः going, दिशः directions.

40021610.author: Translation
40021610.content: Rama then told the Pushpaka, "Depart now, and remember to return whenever I recall you; O gentle one, do not be afflicted with sorrow, and may there be no obstruction to your desired flight in any direction, like that of the Siddhas."

40021611.author: पदार्थः
40021611.content: एवम् thus, अस्तु let it be, इति thus, रामेण by Rama, पूजयित्वा having worshipped, विसर्जितम् dismissed, अभिप्रेताम् desired, दिशम् direction, तस्मात् from there, प्रायात् departed, तत् that, पुष्पकम् Pushpaka, तदा then.

40021611.author: Translation
40021611.content: Having been worshipped and dismissed by Rama with the words "So be it," the Pushpaka then departed from there towards its desired direction.

40021612.author: पदार्थः
40021612.content: एवम् thus, अन्तर्हिते having disappeared, तस्मिन् that, पुष्पके Pushpaka, सुकृतात्मनि of good deeds, भरतः Bharata, प्राञ्जलिः with folded hands, वाक्यम् words, उवाच spoke, रघुनन्दनम् to Rama.

40021612.author: Translation
40021612.content: After that Pushpaka, which was of good deeds, had thus disappeared, Bharata, with folded hands, spoke these words to Rama.

40021613.author: पदार्थः
40021613.content: विविधात्मनि in various forms, दृश्यन्ते are seen, त्वयि in you, वीर O hero, प्रशासति ruling, अमानुषाणाम् of non-human, सत्त्वानाम् beings, व्याहृतानि utterances, मुहुर्मुहुः repeatedly.

40021613.author: Translation
40021613.content: O hero, while you rule, the utterances of non-human beings are repeatedly seen in various forms.

40021614.author: पदार्थः
40021614.content: अनामयः without disease, च and, सत्वानां of beings, साग्रः full, मासः month, गतः passed, हि indeed, अयम् this, जीर्णानाम् of the old, अपि even, सत्त्वानां of beings, मृत्युः death, न not, आयाति comes, राघव O Raghava.

40021614.author: Translation
40021614.content: O Raghava, this full month has passed without any disease among beings, and even for the aged, death does not come.

40021615.author: पदार्थः
40021615.content: अरोगप्रसवाः giving birth without illness, नार्यः women, वपुष्मन्तः healthy, हि indeed, मानवाः humans, हर्षः joy, च and, अभ्यधिकः excessive, राजन् O King, जनस्य of the people, पुरवासिनः of the city dwellers.

40021615.author: Translation
40021615.content: Women give birth without illness, humans are healthy, and O King, the joy of the city dwellers is exceedingly great.

40021616.author: पदार्थः
40021616.content: काले at the proper time, वर्षति rains, पर्जन्यः the cloud, पातयन् causing to fall, अमृतं nectar-like, पयः water, वाताः winds, च and, अपि also, प्रवान्ति blow, एते these, स्पर्शयुक्ताः endowed with pleasant touch, सुखाः pleasant, शिवाः auspicious.

40021616.author: Translation
40021616.content: The clouds rain nectar-like water at the proper time, and these winds blow, pleasant to the touch, agreeable, and auspicious.

40021617.author: पदार्थः
40021617.content: ईदृशः such, अनश्वरः immortal, राजा king, भवेत् may be, इति thus, नरेश्वरः O King, कथयन्ति say, पुरे in the city, राजन् O King, पौरजानपदाः city and country dwellers, तथा also.

40021617.author: Translation
40021617.content: O King, the city and country dwellers say in the city, "May such a king be immortal!"

40021618.author: पदार्थः
40021618.content: एता these, वाचः words, सुमधुरा very sweet, भरतेन by Bharata, समीरिताः spoken, श्रुत्वा having heard, रामः Rama, मुदा with joy, युक्तः filled, बभूव became, नृपसत्तमः the best of kings.

40021618.author: Translation
40021618.content: Having heard these very sweet words spoken by Bharata, Rama, the best of kings, became filled with joy. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे एकचत्वारिंशः सर्गः ।। 41 ।। Thus ends the forty-first sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
